spans.text: ## Request

Liquidity view: CRC’s historical initial discussion budget indicates **Weak near-term liquidity**, dependent on timely DIP access rather than internally generated cash. The weekly opening cash of USD47m becomes negative in the first week without financing; peak weekly funding to retain the USD10m cash target is USD120m. The longer budget reaches USD249m of cash loans at the January 15, 2021 maturity stub. Nominal cash capacity of USD250m nearly covers that balance, but conditionally reserving the planned incremental LCs reduces capacity to USD219m.
